export.routed_expert_down_projections: NVFP4 constrained rounding with scale encodings unchanged
export.shared_expert_down_projections: MXFP8 constrained rounding with scale encodings unchanged
export.configuration_note: The original config contains the ambiguous label accepted (study). Frozen-file hashes and validation identify the accepted continuation directions; original study search scores are not the baked-model scores.

attention_mxfp8_reencode.changed_tensors: 48 attention output projection weights (BF16 -> MXFP8) plus their 48 weight_scale tensors; all in tensors/model-00001-of-00021.safetensors
attention_mxfp8_reencode.method: scale exponent ceil(log2(amax/448)) per 32 inputs (base rule); each element rounds to one of its two nearest E4M3 neighbours; greedy flips cancel the error along the layer removed direction (left singular vector of bake minus base) with minimal added squared error
attention_mxfp8_reencode.fidelity: error along removed direction <= 0.002% of the intervention; relative weight error 1.47-1.93%; removed fraction within 0.00002 of the BF16 bake
attention_mxfp8_reencode.post_processing: The published config.json names the script marker "attention_mxfp8_reencode" (the script writes "qwen50_reencode"), and model.safetensors.index.json metadata.total_size was recomputed from the new tensor sizes; tensor data is exactly as the script wrote it.
